FISCAL NOTE
Senate Bill 97
Committee: Healthcare Sponsor: Senator Gerald Allen
Analyst: Tiffany Weaver Date: 02/25/2026
Senate Bill 97 as introduced would create the Alabama Health Command, as an independent
state agency responsible for designating an entity to develop and provide standards and
qualifications for the utilization of a virtual AI-assisted health platform to be used by rural
health care providers in the state. This could increase the obligations of the State General Fund,
presumably, by an undetermined amount dependent on, at a minimum, the cost to hire a director
to implement and administer the provisions of this bill and any necessary personnel.
